title: I’m a new member, so forgive me if this sort of thing has already been posted:
content: Magnesium. Take magnesium before bedtime. Take ALL of the magnesium. (Not really. Don’t do that.) It’s upsetting to take these pills because even one is only slightly smaller than my fist (not really, I’m being dramatic), and I force myself to take four before bed. My delicate gag reflex dreads this nightly, but it is absolutely worth it. I use 200mg Nature Made High Absorption Magnesium Glycinate, but I’m sure there are bunches of other options. I’m not saying the Mall World will get better or less scary or any easier to navigate, but since we’re all stuck there anyway, things will get way more real and entertaining. Happy dreaming!
